title: Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming"

entities.name: Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for roaming"
entities.description: This Information Element indicates the forbidden Tracking Area Identities (TAIs) to be stored in the list of forbidden tracking areas for roaming. It is included only when the message is sent via satellite E-UTRAN access.

entities.name: Satellite E-UTRAN access condition
entities.description: Condition that the message is sent via satellite E-UTRAN access. This condition determines when the Forbidden TAI(s) IE is included.

entities.name: List of forbidden tracking areas for roaming
entities.description: A stored list in the UE containing Tracking Area Identities (TAIs) that are forbidden for roaming purposes.

relations.description: The inclusion of the Forbidden TAI(s) IE is guarded by the condition that the message is sent via satellite E-UTRAN access.
The Forbidden TAI(s) IE establishes the content to be stored in the list of forbidden tracking areas for roaming.
